questions.topic: The ceiling set by unreliable measures
questions.stem: A field biologist's survey uses an unreliable scale; explain the ceiling on validity.

answer.exemplar: An unreliable measure cannot correlate with anything more highly than its own reliability allows. The observed validity is capped by measurement error, so improving reliability raises the validity ceiling.
